elements.label: hand
elements.description: The cold invisible hand that guides all things. [The Hand is the principle that controls everything.]

elements.label: Heart
elements.description: The Heart represents vitality, emotion, and human connection. Just as Heart bolsters power with human bonds and emotions, The Pride aims to bridge alienation and restore communal unity.

elements.label: Winter
elements.description: The Winter aspect mirrors the calming effect of the Inner Dialogue, akin to a period of mental hibernation where individuals process emotions and experiences, creating a soothing refuge from anxiety.

elements.label: Secret Histories
elements.description: Secret Histories correspond to hidden truths and obscured knowledge, mirroring the aim of Enlensing to reframe perspectives, seeking hidden meanings, and approaching life's mysteries with a fresh lens.

elements.label: Lantern
elements.description: The Lantern embodies enlightenment, understanding, and knowledge. Remembering shares this focus on illumination, bringing obscured or forgotten experiences back into the light.

elements.label: Grail
elements.description: The Grail symbolizes desire and physical experiences. Counter-Spiralling, aligns well with the Grail, offering a broader, more enriching view of life through diverse experiences.

elements.label: Edge
elements.description: The Edge stands for overcoming challenges, synonymous with Flow, representing the endeavor to overcome the sensation of drowning in one's problems, achieving a state of effortless performance.

elements.label: Knock
elements.description: The Knock signifies transitions and the overcoming of barriers, finds a counterpart in Antibodies, providing a way to neutralize harmful foreign influences, liberating individuals from the chains of external entrapment.

elements.label: Forge
elements.description: The Forge stands for transformation and change, paralleling the process of Ego Loosening. This aspect echoes the personal metamorphosis facilitated by Ego Loosening, underscoring the value of adaptability and self-reinvention.

elements.label: Moth
elements.description: The Moth represents secrets, dreams, transformation, and elusive elements, aligns with the concept of Larping, promoting a fluid identity by stepping into different roles and perspectives.
